text: The Canadian Union of Public Employees, Local 5089 (CUPE, Local 5089) bargaining unit is comprised of approximately 275 employees. CUPE, Local 5089 represents the Special Constables, the Provincial Offences Officers, and the Protective Services Guards. This report will provide the TTC Board with details regarding the outcome of contract negotiations between the TTC and CUPE, Local 5089 in arriving at a tentative agreement for a renewal collective bargaining agreement between these parties. The tentative agreement was reached on September 25, 2026.
